name: renku
description: Renku filmmaking skills for screenplay development, and movie-making workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Movie-making skills for writers and filmmakers.
interface.longDescription: Renku is a filmmaking skills library for Codex and Claude Code. Its screenplay skills can reconstruct editor-ready FDX from a screenplay PDF or help writers develop and persist screenplay stories, scenes, and dialogue in Renku Studio.
defaultPrompt: Use Renku to help with this movie-making workflow.
For screenplay work, use $screenplay-drafter to author persisted Renku Studio screenplay JSON.
For screenplay PDF conversion, use $screenplay-pdf-to-fdx to reconstruct and validate an editor-ready FDX file.
